thread.title: U.S. stock futures sharply lower, led by tech as rout continues - MarketWatch

author: Barbara Kollmeyer
title: U.S. stock futures sharply lower, led by tech as rout continues - MarketWatch
text:
An earlier version of this article incorrectly made reference to the day and the point decline for the Dow Jones Industrial Average on Monday. The errors have been fixed.
U.S. stock futures tumbled on Tuesday, a day after heavy losses for Wall Street, with tech stocks again setting up for a tough session. Dow futures YMZ8, -2.44% slid 151 points, or 0.6%, to 24,869, while S&P 500 futures ESZ8, -2.14% dropped 18.55 points, or 0.7%, to 2,678. Nasdaq-100 futures NQZ8, -2.16% tumbled 75.25 points, or 1.1%, to 6,597. On Monday , the Dow industrials DOW, -0.88% slid nearly 400 points on weak economic data and the Nasdaq Composite COMP, -1.70% dropped 3%. Apple Inc. AAPL, -4.78% , a big loser Monday, was again down in premarket amid lingering concerns about demand for its new iPhone models. As well as stock futures oil prices were off sharply, with January West Texas Intermediate crude CLF9, -7.01% down nearly 1% and January Brent crude brnf9 down over 1%.
See Full Story Dow drops 500 points and all 30 components fall, led by Apple’s stock U.S. stock-index futures on Tuesday were set to extend a pre-Thanksgiving rout that has been fueled mostly by a selloff in shares of technology and internet-related companies.
